Do skip connections help segment spacecraft?

Additive skips changed test mIoU by +6.53 percentage points. This is a single-seed, small-data comparison on held-out spacecraft types; the result does not establish general superiority. Selected checkpoints use validation only.

100 SATSEG colour scenes. 65 training / 19 validation / 16 test. RGB and grayscale duplicates are not mixed across splits. Whole spacecraft types are held out.

Measurement conditions and limitations

{"device": "cpu", "threads": 2, "batch_size": 1, "input_shape": [1, 3, 128, 128], "precision": "float32", "mode": "eval + inference_mode", "warmup": 20, "repetitions": 100, "includes": "model forward pass only; excludes disk IO, preprocessing, transfer, argmax and rendering", "test_images": 16, "metric_aggregation": "sum confusion matrices across all valid test pixels; exclude padding ID 255", "threshold": "argmax of 2 logits"}

One seed; small test set; a single validation spacecraft type; possible unrecognised related source photographs; letterboxing to 128 pixels may erase thin structures. Latency is measured on this execution environment and is not a flight-computer benchmark.

Data: Shi and Ulrich, SATSEG, official dataset. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Image IDs appear above. Failures and successes are selected by skip-model foreground IoU, not manually cherry-picked.
